title: Made a traversable wormhole with Opus 5.5 using real curved-spacetime light tracing in Godot
author: Hannonymous07
selftext:
Built with Opus 5.5. For the wormhole each pixel's light ray is traced through the curved space-time geometry of an Ellis / Morris-Thorne-style traversable wormhole (null geodesics through the throat), on the GPU in real time.

You can see the sky bent around the mouth, with an Einstein ring around a window onto the far end. On the inside the stars at the far end wrap around the throat in rings of repeated images. The glowing strands in the tunnel are a luminous medium added for the visuals, plus a few other small artistic liberties. The transition from normal space into the throat is seamless: the ship moves by the same curved geometry the light follows.

The tunnel leads to Alpha Centauri, 4.37 light years away.
